ruleDefinitions.name: DPAPI Backup Keys And Certificate Export Activity IOC
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects file names with specific patterns seen generated and used by tools such as Mimikatz and DSInternals related to exported or stolen DPAPI backup keys and certificates.

sequences.query: ((file_path = RGX(".*ntds\\_capi\\_.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*ntds\\_legacy\\_.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*ntds\\_unknown\\_.*")) AND (file_path = RGX("\\\.cer$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.key$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.pfx$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.pvk$")))
